<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rain of Razors](/Feats.aspx?ID=4261) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 31

</column>

---

Razor-sharp slivers of metal fall from the sky. Each creature in a 20-foot burst within 60 feet takes 9d6 slashing damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. The razors embed in all surfaces in the area, making them [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=454) for 1 minute. A creature that moves through this hazardous terrain takes 3 slashing damage for every square of the area it moves into.

---
**Level (+2)** The initial damage increases by 1d6 and the hazardous terrain damage increases by 1.
name: Rain of Razors
